name: Crystals of Power
summary: J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge asks you to gather Power Crystals in four colors.

sections.title: A Crystal Request
sections.body: At Marshal's Refuge, J.D. Collie asks you to bring her Power Crystals. She wants seven each in red, blue, yellow, and green, and waits for you to return with them.

faq.answer: J.D. Collie asks you to bring her seven Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green.

faq.q: Where do I bring the crystals?
faq.answer: Bring the Power Crystals to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

faq.q: How many crystals of each color?
faq.answer: J.D. Collie asks for seven red, seven blue, seven yellow, and seven green Power Crystals.

attribution: In-game quest text: Crystals of Power
